tools.name: ifc_attributes
tools.description: Returns the raw STEP attributes of an entity, by position. Use this when a value is not exposed as a named property.

tools.name: ifc_bounds
tools.description: Returns the axis-aligned bounding box of the whole model and, unless 'ids' narrows it, of each element. Every box is given as min, max, center and size.

ids.description: Optional comma-separated entity ids to restrict to, e.g. '173,180'. Omit for the whole model.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_close
tools.description: Closes an open IFC file and frees its memory.

tools.name: ifc_element_containment
tools.description: Returns the chain of spatial containers above an element, nearest first — the answer to 'which storey is this door on?'.

tools.name: ifc_entities_of_type
tools.description: Lists every entity of one IFC type, e.g. IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE. Type matching is exact and case-insensitive; use ifc_type_counts to see the types present.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_entity
tools.description: Returns one entity by its STEP id (the number after # in the file), with its type, display name, GlobalId, and raw attributes.

id.description: STEP id of the entity, e.g. 4213 for #4213.

tools.name: ifc_export_glb
tools.description: Meshes a model and writes it to a binary glTF (.glb) file, returning the path and byte size. Set 'ids' to export only specific elements. The whole model is meshed either way; 'ids' only filters which instances are written.

ids.description: Optional comma-separated entity ids to restrict to, e.g. '173,180'. Omit for the whole model.

outputPath.description: Path of the .glb file to write.

tools.name: ifc_find_by_parameter
tools.description: Finds the elements whose parameter satisfies a test, returned in id order with the matched value. Operators: exists, eq, ne, contains, gt, ge, lt, le. Values compare as numbers when both sides read as numbers, otherwise as case-insensitive text; the ordering operators require a numeric value.

name.description: Parameter name, optionally qualified with its set.

op.description: Test to apply. Default 'eq' when a value is given, 'exists' when not.

propertySet.description: Optional exact property set name, if 'name' is bare.

type.description: Optional IFC type to restrict to.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_header
tools.description: Returns the STEP header of an IFC file: description, originating file name, and schema.

tools.name: ifc_mesh
tools.description: Reports the triangle geometry of a model per element: instance, triangle and vertex counts, signed volume, surface area and bounds. Set 'ids' to a comma-separated list to restrict to specific elements. This returns measurements, not raw vertices — use ifc_export_glb to get the geometry itself.

ids.description: Optional comma-separated entity ids to restrict to, e.g. '173,180'. Omit for the whole model.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_meshing_diagnostics
tools.description: Reports whether the mesher succeeded and every message and error it produced — the way to see what geometry could not be built and why. Messages are paged; errors are returned whole.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_models
tools.description: Lists the IFC files currently held open, least recently used first.

tools.name: ifc_open
tools.description: Opens an IFC file and reports its schema and size. Optional — every other tool opens the file on demand — but useful to pay the parse cost once up front.

tools.name: ifc_parameter_table
tools.description: Returns a row per element and a column per named parameter — the way to read the same parameters across many elements in one call instead of ifc_properties per element. Give 'names' as a comma-separated list. Restrict the rows with 'type' or 'ids'; with 'type' every element of that type gets a row, missing values as null.

propertySet.description: Optional exact property set name applied to every bare name.

type.description: Optional IFC type whose elements become the rows.

ids.description: Optional comma-separated entity ids to restrict to, e.g. '173,180'. Omit for the whole model.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_parameter_values
tools.description: Returns the distinct values of one parameter with how many elements hold each, most common first — the distribution of a parameter across the model in one call. Name it bare ('FireRating') or qualified ('Pset_WallCommon.LoadBearing').

name.description: Parameter name, optionally qualified with its set.

propertySet.description: Optional exact property set name, if 'name' is bare.

type.description: Optional IFC type to restrict to.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_parameters
tools.description: Lists every parameter in the model — properties and quantities alike — with the number of elements carrying it, how many distinct values it takes, its numeric range, and sample values. Start here: it tells you what is worth asking about without opening a single element. Filter with 'name', 'propertySet' or 'type'.

name.description: Optional substring the parameter name must contain, e.g. 'fire'.

propertySet.description: Optional substring the property set name must contain, e.g. 'Common'.

type.description: Optional IFC type to count against, e.g. IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_properties
tools.description: Returns the properties attached to an element, grouped by property set name. Quantities are excluded; use ifc_quantities for those.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_property_sets
tools.description: Lists the names and ids of the property sets attached to an element, without their values.

tools.name: ifc_quantities
tools.description: Returns the quantities (length, area, volume, count, weight, time) attached to an element.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_relations
tools.description: Returns the relationship edges touching an entity. Edges run child to parent. Set 'direction' to 'from' for edges where the entity is the child, 'to' for edges where it is the parent, or leave it unset for both.

kind.description: Optional relation kind filter, e.g. ContainedIn, MemberOf, Voids.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_search
tools.description: Finds entities whose name, GlobalId, or type contains the given text (case-insensitive). Set 'type' to restrict the search to one IFC type.

text.description: Text to look for in the entity name, GlobalId, or type.

type.description: Optional IFC type filter, e.g. IFCWALL.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_spatial_contents
tools.description: Lists the elements contained directly in one spatial container, such as a storey.

id.description: STEP id of the spatial container.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_spatial_tree
tools.description: Returns the spatial hierarchy — project, site, building, storey, space — with the number of elements contained directly in each node.

tools.name: ifc_sql
tools.description: Runs a read-only SQL query (DuckDB dialect) over a model's BIM Open Schema tables and returns a page of rows plus the unpaged row count. One SELECT or WITH statement only. Query the EntityText, ParameterText and RelationText views unless you need the raw interned tables. Call ifc_table first to see what exists.

sql.description: A single SELECT or WITH statement.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_sql_export
tools.description: Runs a read-only SQL query and writes every row to a file. The format follows the output extension: .parquet, .json, or CSV with a header row for anything else. Use this instead of paging through ifc_sql for a large result.

sql.description: A single SELECT or WITH statement.

outputPath.description: Path of the file to write.

tools.name: ifc_table
tools.description: Lists the tables and views available to ifc_sql with their row counts and column types, so a query can be written without guessing. Set 'table' to describe just one. Start with the EntityText, ParameterText and RelationText views: the raw tables store interned integer indexes, not names.

table.description: Optional single table to describe, e.g. Entities.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_to_bos
tools.description: Converts a model to BIM Open Schema (a zip of Parquet tables) and builds the DuckDB database that ifc_sql and ifc_table query. Set 'outputPath' to also save the .bos file somewhere permanent. Set 'refresh' to true to redo a conversion after the IFC file has changed on disk. Expensive: it re-reads the whole file.

outputPath.description: Optional path to save a copy of the .bos file to.

refresh.description: Rebuild even if this model has already been converted. Default false.

tools.name: ifc_type_counts
tools.description: Counts entities by IFC type, most common first. The fastest way to see what a model contains.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.

tools.name: ifc_volume
tools.description: Returns signed volume and surface area computed from the meshed geometry: model totals plus a per-element breakdown. Signed volume is negative when a solid's faces wind inward, so its magnitude is the physical volume. Set 'ids' to restrict the breakdown.

ids.description: Optional comma-separated entity ids to restrict to, e.g. '173,180'. Omit for the whole model.

skip.description: Number of items to skip. Default 0.
